alt_closure.evidence: PRIMARY LEG: `a_t <= 9` (stage6_syzygy_collision), independently-audited via at_le9_audit.py (76/76). alt_closure.note: This is what retires GAP-ALT-STATES. That gap measured 39 modelled degree-states against 4690 surviving across the 27 open branches. The 4690 do not need to be modelled one by one: they all sit in branches with `a_t >= 11`, and `a_t <= 9` empties every such branch. The gap is MOOT, and it is retired explicitly rather than silently.

SINGLE LOAD-BEARING NEW INPUT: cascade level 12, `v_t(h_6) >= 11`; --fast (level 10) genuinely fails X9.
